name: Mayosperse 60
description: Mayosperse 60 (CAS 31075-24-8 ), also known as Mackamine LA, is a polymeric quaternary ammonium compound used as a cationic coagulant and biocide across multiple industrial water management applications. Its cationic charge density makes it effective at destabilizing suspended particles and controlling microbial growth in process water systems. In water treatment, it functions as a primary coagulant for clarifying industrial effluents. The compound works by neutralizing negatively charged colloidal particles to improve solids removal in municipal wastewater. Pulp and paper manufacturers apply it to improve retention of fines and fillers on the wire. This application directly impacts sheet formation and reduces raw material losses during production. In textile and leather processing, it supports wastewater decolorization by binding anionic dyes prior to discharge. The compound also serves as a preservative biocide in recirculating cooling water systems and process fluids where microbial control is required. It is supplied as an aqueous liquid solution for industrial systems. This is the standard commercial form for handling and dosing. It is available in technical grade , suitable for industrial water treatment and process applications where high performance is required. Bulk supply is typical for high-volume industrial buyers, with intermediate packaging available for smaller-scale formulators.
